omitted_with_reason: Supplement online-only references are bibliography/provenance and not part of the requested primary-article reference queue.

coverage_decision: All main-text tables and figures and all methodologically or empirically material supplemental tables and figures were included. Pure bibliography pages were not atomized.
omissions: Individual author-contribution roles were not atomized. Individual commercial relationships were summarized in one conflict-of-interest atom rather than one atom per company relationship.

source_integrity_findings.finding: The abstract and Table 2 report different adjusted hazard ratios for any irAE at the 6-week landmark. PFS is 0.525 (95% CI 0.287-0.937; P=.03) in the abstract versus 0.542 (0.295-0.971; P=.04) in Table 2. OS is 0.282 (0.101-0.667; P=.003) in the abstract versus 0.285 (0.102-0.675; P=.003) in Table 2.
source_integrity_findings.handling: Both source assertions were preserved as separate atoms and tagged for source reconciliation. No value was silently corrected.
